own_solution.law: Ohm's law and Joule heating for parallel resistors: P = V^2/R1 + V^2/R2 = V^2/R_eq
assumptions: ideal battery (internal resistance negligible, as stated)

T1374.regime: current through the 6 ohm branch (V/R1 = 2 A) below the fuse threshold, so the fuse does not blow

T7F3F.regime: current through the 6 ohm branch (V/R1 = 2 A) below the fuse rating, so the fuse does not blow

notes: Relation P = V^2(1/R1 + 1/R2) is correct; base 36 W. R answers check: 13.5^2/4 = 45.5625, 15^2/4 = 56.25, 18^2/4 = 81.0 W. K regime V/R1 < q holds for every listed rating (2 A < 3, 5, 10 A); the reference expression V^2/R2 outside the regime (blown fuse opens branch 1) is also correct. The regime is written with a strict inequality while T1374 says the fuse blows only above q; the two conventions differ only at I = q, which no listed value reaches. Minimal pairs T197B/T8967 and T27DC/T24CC share 3 V and differ only in attachment. Agrees with pass 1.
